cross_verification.note: evisacam.cm confirmed as the official Cameroon e-visa portal, but the fetchable homepage exposes no photo specification (details are gated behind the login/application flow). Third-party sources give conflicting numbers for Cameroon visa photos (35x45mm white background vs 2x2 inch for US-consulate applicants vs 4x4cm), which itself signals no single reliable public standard could be confirmed; all such non-official figures were excluded per the truthfulness gate.
